liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (1 review): Loser transitioning into The Music Never Stopped was described as a ripping performance [11]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Dark Star sounded stiff and march-like, as if drummers forgot how to jazz it up [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-10.sonyecm-wagner.minches.77328.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 199 min; rated 2.71/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1979-01-10.sony-senn.wagner.miller.113114.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 200 min; rated 5/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd1979-01-10.157175.fob.3MicMix.wagner.miller.t.flac1644**: source not stated; 23 songs; 201 min [4]
- **gd79-01-10.gatto.kempka.307.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 177 min; rated 4.43/5 by 35 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording features great sound quality, opening and closing with Chuck Berry songs; Instruments are clear, but vocals are very much missed, sounding like standing 100 rows away [14][16]

## Around the show

- The audience witnessed a spaceship descend during the jam, scrambling their psychedelic souls [15]
- The band played without pyrotechnics, which were popular then, yet still blew the listener away [19]
- Fans scrambled from the nosebleed section to the floor when Dark Star began [21]
- The second set was compared to Winterland caliber and presaged the Wynton show ten years later [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-10.sonyecm-wagner.minches.77328.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sony ECM-4 Ps w/ Senn 421 blend> Sony 158 [1]
- **gd1979-01-10.sony-senn.wagner.miller.113114.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony 54P + (1) Sennheiser 441 -> Namakichi 550 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD/Maxell UDXLII-S90/Dolby B) [2]. Also: Bob Wagner lent his masters, and Joe B. Jones assisted with pitch correction [2]
- **gd1979-01-10.157175.fob.3MicMix.wagner.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 25, 2022; source: (FOB) (2)Sony 54P + (1)Sennheiser 441 > Namakichi 550 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD/Maxell UDXLII-S90/Dolby B) [4]. Also: Bob Wagner provided masters, and Joe B. Jones helped with the previous project version [4]
- **gd79-01-10.gatto.kempka.307.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Keith Gatto; source: Audience Recording: Nak 300's [6]
